api_doc_gaps.endpoint: read path for an event-type rule's lines (API-FIN-009/010 response, or GET /fin/event-rules/{id})
api_doc_gaps.detail: EventTypeRuleResponse carried no lines[] and no by-id read existed, so SCR-FIN-003's Detail pane had no data source; F1-SCR-FIN-003 asserted 'RuleLine (embedded in response)', which the published shape did not support.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: RESOLVED — lines[] + lineCount added on all three event-rule endpoints; verified field-by-field in governance-shared@9939077 on 2026-09-19.

api_doc_gaps.detail: FiscalPeriodResponse carries only a numeric fiscalYearId, so SCR-FIN-007's year master could render no attribute, and API-FIN-030/031 (fiscalYearId required) had no selector source.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: RESOLVED — endpoint served, returning code, startDate, endDate, statusCode, isActiveFl, periodCount; verified in governance-shared@9939077 on 2026-09-19.

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: filters[].field / sortField on all nine FIN search endpoints
api_doc_gaps.detail: The generic SearchFilter DSL published no whitelist, so no client could know which field names were honoured; a dropped filter is indistinguishable from one that matched everything (the SEC sessions/search failure mode).
api_doc_gaps.resolution: RESOLVED — 'Supported fields:' and 'Supported:' published per endpoint, including the three structural filters parentAccountId, dimensionId and fiscalYearId; verified in governance-shared@9939077 on 2026-09-19.

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: filters[].operator on lifted fields (parentAccountId, fiscalYearId, periodId, dimensionId, sourceAccountId)
api_doc_gaps.detail: HANDOVER-FE-fin-blockers-2026-09-19.md §6 states a non-EQUALS operator on these fields is silently coerced to EQUALS, not rejected. api-docs@9939077 states on every search that an operator a field does not list is rejected as 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming it. Both cannot hold; error handling is being written against one of them.

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: six served endpoints: fiscal-years/search, fiscal-periods/search, and the four deactivates
api_doc_gaps.detail: registry-exec-be-fin.md still declares API-FIN-001..032, so six served endpoints carry no contract id and every api-docs regeneration drops them again. The frontend resolves them only through _inputs/api-docs-binding-fin.md (ADR-FIN-002), which is a workaround, not a contract. Neither track can edit the registry; the factory must issue the ids.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — also reported from the backend side in erp/modules/FIN/backend/execution-state.json (governance-shared@0862bc7).

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: SEC module/screen/action registration for FIN (REQ-FIN-044), read back through API-SEC-027
api_doc_gaps.detail: Every FIN route is guarded by its page code being present in the effective menu (ADR-FIN-005, screen-level only per ADR-SEC-005). Until FIN registers its twelve page codes into SEC, no FIN route is reachable for any caller including an admin, so no built screen can be verified in a browser.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — asked in backend-prompt-fin-frontend-blockers-2026-09-19.md §6(a), unanswered; re-asked in round-2 §4(a).

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: MDL seeding of FIN's eleven non-host lookup keys (REQ-FIN-045)
api_doc_gaps.detail: All twelve UXD-FIN-* resolve through GET /api/v1/mdl/lookups?type=. An unseeded key renders an empty select on a required field, and no client-side default is invented (ADR-FIN-004). Confirmation that V26 covers the eleven on a fresh database has not been given.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — asked in backend-prompt-fin-frontend-blockers-2026-09-19.md §6(b), unanswered; re-asked in round-2 §4(b).

api_doc_gaps.detail: MDL's api-docs publishes this endpoint with no contract id, yet twelve UXD-FIN-* dependencies resolve through it. Same class of gap as the six FIN ids, in another module.

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: where api-docs belong on this profile — no profile key declares the destination
api_doc_gaps.detail: The two halves never met: origin/main carried FIN's api-docs on the old erp/ tree while the plan, its split packages and this partition lived on a branch origin had never seen. MERGED and pushed as governance-shared@34ffe0c — main merged into the v7 layout, 689 renames resolved by git, one file-location conflict (SEC dev-support.md) resolved, verified blob-by-blob with no content lost and the backend partition byte-identical. What the merge did NOT fix: platform/profile-summary.json still declares no key stating where api-docs belong, so the generator keeps inferring the destination — the inference that misfiled FIN's docs twice on 2026-09-19. The backend filed the same finding (governance-shared@cb75bde).
api_doc_gaps.resolution: HUMAN — the tree split is RESOLVED at 34ffe0c; what remains needs gov.py publish to emit a declared api-docs destination key in profile-summary.json, which neither track can write.
